name: Knight of Grues
source:
“Exterminating the monsters that had taken up residence in the supposedly depleted magical mine”—
that was the mission entrusted to Volker.
According to the scouts’ reports, the confirmed monsters were only low-level creatures like slimes and tentacles.
The magic detected inside the magical mine was minimal, not enough to raise any alarm.
Although he was newly appointed, there was no task that a knight like Volker couldn’t handle.
Everyone believed that his decision to suppress the monsters alone, without hiring mercenaries, was by no means reckless.
…At least, that was the case up to this point.
translation:
“消灭那些栖息在据说已经枯竭的魔法矿井中的怪物”——
这就是沃尔克所肩负的使命。
根据斥候的报告，确认的怪物只是史莱姆、触手之类的低级生物。
魔矿内检测到的魔力微乎其微，不足以引起任何警报。
虽然是新任命的，但没有什么任务是沃尔克这样的骑士解决不了的。
所有人都认为，他不雇佣雇佣兵，独自镇压怪物的决定，绝非鲁莽。
……至少到目前为止是这样。
